test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow properly enforces document checks and governance approvals before site activation
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Test study created in CTMS
Test site profile created
Required document templates uploaded
Test users with appropriate roles configured

test_steps.action: Log in as a clinical operations user and initiate site activation workflow for test site
test_steps.expected_result: System displays site activation workflow with required document checklist

test_steps.action: Attempt to complete activation without uploading required documents (protocol, IB, etc.)
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents activation and displays error message indicating missing documents

test_steps.action: Upload all required documents and submit for approval
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts documents and routes workflow to appropriate approvers based on governance rules

test_steps.action: Log in as approver and complete the approval process
test_steps.expected_result: System updates site status to 'Activated' and records all approval signatures

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces all document requirements
System prevents activation without required documents
Approval process follows configured governance rules
All steps are properly recorded in audit trail
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic signatures
ICH E6 R2 requirements for site qualification
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail records all workflow steps
Document version control maintained
Approval signatures are 21 CFR Part 11 compliant

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Access Control for CRO and Sponsor Users
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured role-based access control properly restricts user permissions based on organizational affiliation and role
prerequisites: CTMS system is installed and configured
Test users created with CRO and sponsor roles
Test study and site data available
Access control matrix defined

test_steps.action: Log in as a CRO monitor user and attempt to access sponsor-only financial reports
test_steps.expected_result: System denies access and displays appropriate authorization error message

test_steps.action: Log in as sponsor clinical lead and verify access to all study data and reports
test_steps.expected_result: System grants appropriate access to study data, sites, subjects, and reports

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify study configuration settings as a non-administrator user
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents configuration changes and displays insufficient privileges message

test_steps.action: Verify that CRO users can only access sites assigned to them
test_steps.expected_result: System restricts CRO user access to only assigned sites and related data

acceptance_criteria: Access controls enforce separation between CRO and sponsor users
Role-based permissions restrict functions appropriately
System prevents unauthorized access to sensitive data
Error messages do not disclose system information
regulatory_basis: ICH E6 R2 monitoring oversight requirements
data_integrity_requirements: Access attempts are logged in audit trail
User permissions are consistently enforced
No unauthorized data access occurs

test_cases.test_name: Site Activation Workflow with Document Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured site activation workflow correctly enforces document checks and approval steps before a site can be activated for subject enrollment.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with test user accounts
Test study protocol is configured
Test site master data is loaded
Required document templates are available

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS as a Clinical Operations Manager and navigate to the Site Management module.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the Site Management interface for the test study.

test_steps.action: Initiate the site activation workflow for a test site by selecting it and choosing 'Begin Activation'.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the site activation workflow with a checklist of required documents (e.g., FDA 1572, CVs, Lab Certs).

test_steps.action: Upload a subset of the required documents, but omit at least one mandatory document.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the uploads but prevents progression to the next step, indicating which documents are still missing.

test_steps.action: Upload the final missing mandatory document and attempt to submit the activation request for approval.
test_steps.expected_result: System allows submission and routes the request to the configured approver (e.g., Study Lead) for electronic signature.

test_steps.action: Log in as the approver, review the submission, and apply a compliant e-signature to approve.
test_steps.expected_result: System records the e-signature, updates the site status to 'Activated', and logs the approval in the audit trail.

acceptance_criteria: Site activation workflow enforces completion of all required document checks before allowing submission.
Approval step requires a 21 CFR Part 11-compliant e-signature.
Site status is only updated to 'Activated' after final approval.
All steps and document uploads are recorded in the audit trail.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all changes to site status and document upload events.
E-signatures must be bound to the approval action with timestamp and meaning.

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Milestone and Tax Configuration
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured payment rules correctly calculate investigator payments based on milestones and apply the appropriate tax withholding calculations.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is accessible with Finance user role
Test study with payment terms is configured
Test sites with activated status are available
Tax rate configuration is completed

test_steps.action: Log into the CTMS as a Finance user and navigate to the Financial Management module.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the Financial Management dashboard and payment setup.

test_steps.action: Select a test site and manually trigger a payment milestone (e.g., 'First Subject Enrolled') by updating the subject enrollment status.
test_steps.expected_result: System detects the milestone event and generates a pending payment record with the gross amount defined in the study contract.

test_steps.action: Review the generated payment record and verify the system has applied the configured tax withholding percentage to calculate the net payment.
test_steps.expected_result: Payment record displays correct gross amount, calculated tax withholding, and final net amount payable.

test_steps.action: Initiate the payment approval workflow and apply an e-signature as an authorized approver.
test_steps.expected_result: System records the approval and updates the payment status to 'Approved', locking the record from further changes.

test_steps.action: Access the audit trail for the approved payment record and verify all calculations and status changes are logged.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail shows a complete history of the payment creation, calculation, approval, and any subsequent modifications.

acceptance_criteria: Payment milestones are automatically triggered by the corresponding clinical events (e.g., enrollment).
Gross-to-net payment calculations, including tax withholding, are performed accurately based on configured rules.
Payment approval requires a compliant e-signature and results in a locked record.
The entire payment lifecycle is captured in a secure, time-stamped audit trail.
regulatory_basis: Financial procedural controls for clinical trials
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations must be accurate and reproducible.
Audit trail must prevent modification or deletion of financial records after approval.

test_cases.test_name: Monitoring Visit Workflow and Financial Milestone Configuration
test_cases.objective: Verify the configured workflows for monitoring visit planning, execution, report generation, and the associated financial milestone payments function as specified.
prerequisites: Test environment with configured CTMS
Test study created
Test sites activated
Test user with CRA and financial roles
Configured visit templates and payment rules

test_steps.action: Log in as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) and navigate to the monitoring visit planning module.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access the visit planning interface for assigned studies.

test_steps.action: Create a new monitoring visit plan for a test site, scheduling it for a future date and assigning the configured visit report template.
test_steps.expected_result: Visit plan is successfully created, appears in the CRA's schedule, and is linked to the correct template.

test_steps.action: Simulate completing the visit by opening the trip report template, entering test findings, and submitting the report for approval.
test_steps.expected_result: System allows data entry into the template, saves the draft, and the report status changes to 'Submitted' or 'Pending Approval'.

test_steps.action: Log in as a user with approval authority and approve the submitted monitoring visit report.
test_steps.expected_result: System allows the user to review and electronically sign the report, triggering a status change to 'Approved'.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the financial management module and verify that a payment milestone associated with the approved visit report has been automatically triggered.
test_steps.expected_result: A payment record is generated for the correct site and investigator, reflecting the configured milestone amount and tax withholding rules.

acceptance_criteria: Monitoring visit planning and reporting workflow executes without errors.
Trip report templates are correctly populated and enforce required data entry.
E-signature process is 21 CFR Part 11 compliant.
Approval of the visit report automatically triggers the correct financial milestone payment.
All steps generate a complete and accurate audit trail.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
ICH E6(R2) - Section 5.18 - Trial Management, Data Handling, and Record Keeping
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must capture all changes to visit plans, reports, and financial records.
E-signatures must be bound to the respective report and include timestamp and meaning.
Financial calculations must be accurate and traceable to configured rules.

test_cases.test_name: Risk-Based Monitoring Dashboard and Standard Report Generation
test_cases.objective: Validate the functionality of configured risk-based monitoring Key Performance Indicator (KPI) dashboards and the generation of standard operational reports.
prerequisites: Test environment with configured CTMS
Test study with populated data (sites, subjects, visits, deviations)
Test user with access to dashboards and reporting
Configured KPI thresholds and report templates

test_steps.action: Log in to the CTMS and navigate to the main risk-based monitoring dashboard for a test study.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads and displays the configured KPIs (e.g., enrollment rate, query aging, protocol deviation rate) with current data.
data_to_capture: Accuracy of displayed values against source data

test_steps.action: Drill down into a specific KPI widget (e.g., 'Sites with High Deviation Rate') to view the underlying list of sites.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays a detailed list or report showing the sites that meet the KPI criteria, with relevant data points.
data_to_capture: Accuracy of the filtered site list
Data points shown in the detail view

test_steps.action: Navigate to the standard reports library and execute the 'Subject Enrollment Status' report for the test study.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is generated and displays a summary of subject enrollment figures (screened, enrolled, completed) per site.

test_steps.action: Execute the 'Monitoring Visit Status' report and filter the results for a specific date range and 'Overdue' status.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates successfully and lists only the monitoring visits that are overdue within the specified date range.

test_steps.action: Export the generated 'Subject Enrollment Status' report to PDF format and save the file.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is exported to a PDF file without data corruption, and the file includes a timestamp and report title.
data_to_capture: Integrity of data in the PDF

acceptance_criteria: All configured KPI dashboards load and display accurate, real-time data.
Drill-down functionality from KPIs provides correct detailed information.
Standard reports generate within the required performance threshold (<15 seconds).
Report filters work correctly and return accurate subsets of data.
Exported reports maintain data integrity and include necessary metadata.
data_integrity_requirements: Dashboard data must be a real-time reflection of the underlying database.
Reports must be reproducible and generate consistent results for the same input criteria.
Exported data must be an accurate and complete representation of the on-screen report.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the configured monitoring visit planning, trip report generation, and follow-up letter creation workflows function correctly using vendor templates.
prerequisites: CTMS environment is operational
Test user with monitor role credentials
Configured visit templates and follow-up letter templates
Test study and site created in system

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS with monitor role credentials and navigate to visit planning module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access visit planning functionality

test_steps.action: Create a new monitoring visit plan for a test site with scheduled dates and objectives
test_steps.expected_result: Visit plan is successfully created and appears in the monitoring visit calendar

test_steps.action: Complete a trip report using the vendor template after marking visit as completed
test_steps.expected_result: Trip report template loads correctly and allows data entry with all required fields

test_steps.action: Generate a follow-up letter using the configured template and verify content
test_steps.expected_result: Follow-up letter is generated with correct site information and visit details

acceptance_criteria: All monitoring visit workflow steps complete successfully
Templates render correctly with study/site data
Follow-up letters contain accurate visit information
Audit trail records all visit-related actions

Data must not be editable after final submission

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration and Tax Withholding Test
test_cases.objective: Validate that the configured payment milestone rules and tax withholding calculations function correctly for investigator payments.

Test user with finance role credentials
Configured payment milestone rules
Test site with payment terms defined
Tax withholding rules configured

test_steps.action: Log into CTMS with finance role credentials and navigate to payments module
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can access payment management functionality

test_steps.action: Trigger a payment milestone for a test site by completing the required study activity
test_steps.expected_result: System automatically generates payment request upon milestone completion

test_steps.action: Review the calculated payment amount and verify tax withholding calculations
test_steps.expected_result: Payment amount is calculated correctly according to contract terms with proper tax withholding

test_steps.expected_result: Payment moves through approval workflow with proper electronic signatures and audit trail

test_cases.test_name: Investigator Payment Configuration and Tax Withholding Verification
test_cases.objective: Verify that the CTMS correctly calculates investigator payments based on configured milestone rules and properly applies tax withholding calculations according to sponsor requirements.
prerequisites: Payment milestone rules configured in CTMS
Tax withholding rates configured per country
Test investigator site with payment data
User with financial management permissions logged in

test_steps.action: Navigate to the payment management module and select a test investigator site with completed milestones
test_steps.expected_result: System displays the site payment dashboard with pending and completed payments

test_steps.action: Trigger payment calculation for a completed enrollment milestone with configured payment amount
test_steps.expected_result: System calculates gross payment amount according to configured milestone rules

test_steps.action: Verify tax withholding calculation based on investigator's country tax rate configuration
test_steps.expected_result: System correctly applies tax withholding percentage and calculates net payment amount

test_steps.action: Generate payment report and verify all calculations are accurately reflected
test_steps.expected_result: Payment report displays gross amount, tax withheld, and net payment with correct values

acceptance_criteria: Payment calculations match configured milestone rules exactly
Tax withholding calculations apply correct percentages based on country settings
All payment data is accurately reflected in generated reports
System maintains audit trail of all payment calculations and modifications
regulatory_basis: Financial record retention requirements per sponsor policy
data_integrity_requirements: Payment calculations must be accurate and reproducible
Tax rates must be correctly applied based on configured parameters
All payment transactions must be auditable

test_cases.test_name: Risk-Based Monitoring KPI Dashboard Configuration and Performance
test_cases.objective: Validate that risk-based monitoring KPIs are correctly calculated and displayed on dashboards, and ensure dashboard performance meets required response times under load conditions.
prerequisites: KPI metrics configured in CTMS
Test data with monitoring visit results
Performance testing environment setup
User with monitoring dashboard access permissions

test_steps.action: Access the risk-based monitoring dashboard with pre-configured KPI metrics
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard loads within 5 seconds displaying all configured KPIs and metrics

test_steps.action: Verify calculation accuracy for key risk indicators including query rates, SDV completion, and protocol deviation rates
test_steps.expected_result: All KPI calculations match expected values based on test data set

test_steps.action: Simulate concurrent user load of 200 users accessing dashboards simultaneously
test_steps.expected_result: All dashboard requests complete within 15 seconds under load conditions

test_steps.action: Test dashboard filtering and drill-down capabilities with large data sets (1M+ records)
test_steps.expected_result: Filtered views and detailed reports generate within 15 seconds as specified in performance requirements

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads within 5 seconds for single user access
All KPI calculations are accurate and reflect current monitoring data
System supports 200 concurrent users with response times under 15 seconds
Report generation completes within 15 seconds for datasets up to 1M records
regulatory_basis: Risk-based monitoring principles per ICH E6(R2)
Performance requirements for clinical trial systems
Data integrity requirements for monitoring oversight
data_integrity_requirements: KPI calculations must be accurate and based on verified source data
Dashboard data must refresh correctly with current monitoring information
All filtering and reporting must maintain data consistency
